Hyderabad
Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Hyderabad only
Notice period: 15 days

Professional Summary
Azure-focused DevOps engineer with hands-on experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms and CI/CD pipelines. Skilled in infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration, with a track record of improving deployment velocity and reliability across payment and SaaS systems. Seeking Hyderabad-based opportunities.

Technical Skills
Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Docker, PowerShell, Angular, TypeScript, Confluence, Linux

Work Experience

Azure DevOps Engineer, PhonePe (Mar 2023 - Present)
- Implemented Terraform modules to provision Azure resource groups, AKS clusters and networking components, reducing environment provisioning time by ~60% while maintaining consistency; used Azure DevOps pipelines for automated deployments.
- Designed and maintained Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts for payment microservices running on AKS, improving rollout stability and enabling zero-downtime deploys; integrated health probes and resource limits.
- Automated operational tasks and release validations using PowerShell scripts integrated into Azure DevOps pipelines, cutting manual intervention during release windows by 50%.

Cloud Engineer, Infosys (Jan 2023 - Feb 2023)
- Migrated containerized workloads into AKS using Docker images and Helm, standardizing deployment patterns and reducing image size through multi-stage builds.
- Wrote Terraform configurations to provision Azure storage, networking and compute resources for a proof-of-concept client environment and validated deployments in CI pipelines.
- Collaborated on cluster hardening and namespace isolation strategies in Kubernetes to meet client security requirements, documenting processes in Confluence.

Azure DevOps Engineer, Freshworks (Aug 2021 - Dec 2022)
- Built and managed Azure DevOps pipelines for CI/CD of SaaS components deployed to AKS, integrating container image scanning and artifact versioning.
- Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform for staging and production environments in Azure, enforcing tag and policy compliance.
- Worked with Microsoft Azure services for monitoring and logging; implemented cluster autoscaling and optimized resource requests/limits for cost control.

Angular Developer, Accenture (Dec 2019 - Jul 2021)
- Developed front-end features in Angular and TypeScript for enterprise web applications, delivering responsive UI components and improving load times.
- Integrated front-end builds into CI processes and collaborated with backend teams to define APIs and interface contracts; maintained component libraries and documentation in Confluence.

Education
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
